'''Arak Omis''' was the [[Taal]] of the [[Aramandi]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Pushy and argumentative, Omis was a former member of the [[Cirra]] [[akia]]. He was praised for his ability to resolve inter-akia disputes. Omis sought to keep the Aramandi out of the affairs of otherworlders, and constantly rebuffed the advances of [[Lant Mining Corporation]] to open up [[Mining/Legends|mining]] ventures in the [[Aramand Cluster]].
